text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting solid single-day gains—BTC up 3.3% and ETH outpacing it at 4.2%—suggesting some institutional or strategic buying despite the Fear & Greed index sitting at 25 (extreme fear). BTC dominance holding steady near 57% indicates altcoins are participating in the move rather than capital rotating away, which is typical of early-stage recoveries. The $72B in 24h volume is moderate, not elevated, implying this uptick is measured rather than driven by panic-buying or euphoric FOMO.
